title: Solutions Architect
description:
FEQ427R142

As a Solutions Architect, you will lead the technical strategy for your customers - owning architecture discussions, driving platform adoption, and serving as a trusted advisor to customer technical leads and architects. You combine deep technical expertise with strategic thinking to position Databricks as the foundation of your customers’ data and AI strategy. You are developing a technical specialization (archetype) and are recognized within your team for depth in a specific domain.

The Impact You Will Have

• Own the end-to-end technical strategy for your accounts, from initial discovery through production deployment and consumption growth

• Lead complex architecture discussions - designing scalable, production-grade solutions spanning data engineering, ML/AI, and real-time analytics

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customer architects, engineering leads, and Directors

• Drive technical wins in competitive scenarios by demonstrating Databricks’ differentiation through custom-built solutions

• Develop and declare an emerging technical specialization (archetype) - becoming a go-to resource for your team in that domain

• Orchestrate cross-functional resources (DSAs, SSAs, Partners) to deliver comprehensive solutions for complex customer needs

• Influence product direction by providing structured feedback on customer requirements and competitive gaps

What We Look For

• 5+ years in solutions architecture, data engineering, technical pre-sales, or a senior hands-on technical role

• Strong coding proficiency in Python and SQL - you must demonstrate live coding, debugging, and solution-building skills

• Deep expertise in distributed data systems architecture: designing scalable pipelines, streaming architectures, lakehouse patterns, and cloud-native data platforms

• Proficient on the Databricks Platform (or demonstrated ability to achieve proficiency rapidly) with a developing technical specialization in one area (e.g., real-time/streaming, ML/AI, data governance, migrations)

• Proven ability to lead architecture discussions with senior technical stakeholders - whiteboarding, design reviews, and trade-off analysis

• Experience with production deployments on public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including infrastructure, security, and governance considerations

• Track record of driving platform adoption and consumption growth within accounts

• Excellent communication skills - able to translate complex architectures into business value for both technical and executive audiences

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline (or equivalent experience)

Nice to Have:

• Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, ML, Platform)

• Experience with competitive platforms (Snowflake, AWS native services, Azure Synapse) - understanding the landscape you'll position against

• Background in a data/AI company or cloud provider

• Industry domain expertise (Financial Services, Healthcare, Retail, Media, etc.)

Interview Process: Recruiter Screen → Hiring Manager Screen → Design and Architecture Interview → Live Coding Assessment → Build, Demo, Pitch! Presentation → Reference Check

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide - including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 - rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

title: Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

- Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

- Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

- Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

- Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

- Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

- Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

- A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

- The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

- Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LL

title: Data/ETL Engineer (Senior)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Data/ETL Engineer to sustain SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), develop approved integrations, and maintain reliable data pipelines supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
This position will implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers using SQL, Python, APIs, and incremental loading techniques. The engineer will reconcile data, manage schema changes, maintain lineage, and troubleshoot complex pipeline failures to support accurate and timely mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.
The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will work with the Lead Data/ETL Engineer, database administrators, data governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to maintain secure, traceable, and supportable data integrations.
This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Senior Data/ETL Engineer will:

• Sustain, troubleshoot, and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, and dependencies.

• Develop and maintain approved integrations between source systems, databases, APIs, analytical environments, and reporting platforms.

• Write SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation routines.

• Develop Python scripts for data ingestion, processing, validation, orchestration, and operational automation.

• Implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.

• Build and maintain incremental loads, including checkpoints and tracking of previously processed data.

• Implement API authentication, pagination, retry handling, logging, and error processing.

• Reconcile source and target data using record counts, totals, completeness checks, and business rules.

• Manage schema changes and assess their effects on pipelines, datasets, integrations, and reporting outputs.

• Maintain source-to-target mappings, identifier mappings, metadata, and data lineage.

• Implement controls for duplicate, missing, invalid, or failed records and support controlled reprocessing.

• Monitor pipeline execution, data freshness, processing performance, and operational errors.

• Investigate complex failures involving SSIS, SQL, APIs, source data, transformations, and downstream dependencies.

• Implement approved corrections and validate successful processing and reconciliation.

• Coordinate changes with database, application, governance, AI/ML, BI, and testing teams.

• Support automated regression testing, data-quality checks, defect resolution, and release validation.

• Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.

• Provide technical status, troubleshooting findings, risks, and improvement recommendations to the technical lead and Government stakeholders.
Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

• Active Secret clearance or higher.

• Minimum of eight years of relevant professional experience.

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.

• Experience maintaining and supporting SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).

• Strong SQL and Python skills.

• Experience building or supporting API integrations.

• Experience implementing incremental data loads.

• Experience performing data reconciliation and managing schema changes.

• Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage.

• Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines.

• Ability to implement raw, standardized, and curated data layers.

• CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification when applicable to assigned duties.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Trust & Safety
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Zen team, you will be responsible for building the systems that help keep counterfeit items off Vinted, while protecting legitimate sellers.

Zen sits in the Trust domain and owns the counterfeit detection problem end to end, not just the tools. We combine rules, machine learning and modern AI to find counterfeit listings, understand where detection falls short and keep improving it. The work has a direct impact on how safe and trustworthy Vinted is for our members, and we're growing our use of AI to make that protection work at Vinted's scale.

We work with Go, Ruby and Python, alongside ML models and LLMs.

In this position, you’ll 

• Design and build the backend services behind counterfeit detection.

• Spot new counterfeiting patterns early and turn them into new detection capabilities.

• Take technical ownership of complex projects, from idea to production, including writing RFCs and making architecture decisions.

• Build AI-driven capabilities, including LLM-based systems, that are reliable, observable and cost-aware.

• Collaborate with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and bringing engineering input to how detection and models are improved.

• Measure the impact of what we ship, with accuracy and fairness to legitimate sellers in mind.

• Raise the bar for engineering and agentic development by mentoring engineers in the team and beyond.

About you 

• Proven experience designing, building and operating ML- and data-driven backend systems in production, with Go, Ruby or Python, including event-driven systems.

• Curiosity and drive to explore and apply AI to counterfeit detection, staying on top of the latest developments in LLMs and their practical applications.

• Solid understanding of data, ML and LLMs: how models are trained, evaluated and retrained, and how to build reliable systems around them.

• Comfortable working with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and contributing valuable engineering input.

• Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous problems end to end and drive technical decisions.

• Pragmatic about trade-offs between catching abuse and protecting legitimate sellers, and able to explain technical decisions to non-engineers.

• Bonus: experience with BigQuery, Vespa, Temporal

title: Communications and Political Associate
description:
Blue Rose Research helps Democrats win elections and advance progressive causes. We work with campaigns and progressive organizations across the country to produce research and build the tools they use to decide what to say and where to spend.
We are hiring a Communications and Political Associate to help turn our research into clear, useful materials for political leaders, clients, and the press. This is an early-career role focused on drafting, research, and coordination, with guidance and review from senior staff.
What you'll do
Messaging and communications

• Draft and edit memos, presentations, and other client-facing materials, bringing together research findings and relevant background.

• Draft talking points, Q&A documents, and briefing materials for press appearances, with leadership review. Keep past materials organized for reuse.

• Monitor news and media coverage to identify opportunities for timely polling and message testing.

Political research and outreach

• Prepare research summaries and background materials for Blue Rose staff ahead of briefings with Democratic campaigns, elected officials, advocacy organizations, and other political partners.

• Collect and organize talking points, public statements, and social media content for message testing.

What you'll bring

• Typically 1-3 years of experience in Democratic politics, campaigns, legislative offices, or progressive advocacy. Internship experience counts.

• Strong writing and editing skills, including the ability to turn research into clear, accurate talking points, memos, and briefing materials.

• Comfort coordinating meetings and materials with political staff, clients, and media contacts, with guidance from senior staff.

• Working knowledge of Democratic politics, key organizations, and the current news landscape.

• Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage schedules, drafts, and requests under tight deadlines.

• Good judgment about when to take initiative, ask questions, and flag a problem, and a willingness to revise work based on feedback.

• A commitment to helping Democrats win and using research to inform political decisions.

Helpful, but not required

• Experience with polling, message testing, or political research. A quantitative or research background is welcome but not required.

• Experience with media training or interview preparation.

What we offer

• Salary $65-75K annually, depending on experience.

• We offer medical, dental, vision, 401k match, 20 weeks paid parental leave, fertility and family-building support through Maven Clinic, and unlimited PTO.

• Based in Washington, D.C., is strongly preferred, but not required.

Candidates must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States.

title: Medical Monitor - CNS
description:
The Medical Monitor (MM) plays a critical role in overseeing the safety and efficacy of clinical trials, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, providing medical oversight, and performing medical data reviews to ensure patient safety and data integrity. Collaborates with Project Manager, Safety/Pharmacovigilance (PvG), Data Management, Biostatistics, QA, Principal Investigator and Sub-investigators, Site Coordinators, the Data Monitoring Committee (DMC), and any other group that directly or indirectly protects the safety of study participants.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
Clinical Trial Medical Oversight: Provide medical, scientific, and safety oversight for clinical trials, ensuring protocol adherence, participant safety, eligibility, IP dosing, and management of AEs/SAEs/SUSARs, with 24/7 coverage and backup support as needed.
Safety Review & Risk Management: Lead and support ongoing safety data review, including medical coding, patient narratives, Risk Management Plans, MedWatch reporting, and collaboration with Safety/PvG, DMCs, and cross‑functional teams.
Site & Investigator Support: Serve as the primary medical point of contact for investigators, site staff, and sponsors; participate in site selection, SIVs, investigator meetings, site visits, and protocol deviation and root‑cause assessments.
Data & Document Review: Conduct regular medical review of clinical data, CRFs, medical plans, informed consent forms, and study documents; contribute to Investigator’s Brochure content and interpretation of early‑phase trial data.
Trial Design & Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Provide medical input into protocol development and amendments, clinical development plans, study reports, and scientific presentations, working closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, and other departments.
Training, Mentorship & Representation: Train and mentor staff on therapeutic area and clinical research principles, support proposals and commercial activities as needed, and represent the organization at professional meetings.
Qualifications:

• Doctorate degree in medicine or Doctor of Psychology (Psy.D), preferrably with specialization in a CNS therapeutic area. Active license preferred but not required.

• Minimum 5+ years medical monitoring or study physician in clinical research, or similar position in pharamceutical industry or CRO. Some supervisory experience preferred. Specialized CNS knowledge helpful.

• Demonstrate effective leadership of other medical or clinical research colleagues and proficiency with data review activities and use of various technologies utilized to display data (e.g., listings, patient profiles, databases and systems, and/or data visualization tools).

• Advanced knowledge of FDA guidance regarding clinical research trials.

• Strong understanding of medical terminology and drug-names, clinical trial processes, GCP, and regulatory requirements.

• Able to interact with and train others and build constructive, trusting, and respectful working relationships with colleagues and clients at all levels.

• Proficient computer skills (Word documents and spreadsheets) and email.

• Excellent written and oral communications skills (and group presentations).

• Sound critical thinking and problem solving skills.

• Able to execute position responsibilities with minimum guidance.

• Time management and ability to prioritize.

• Customer focused and discplined approach to work.

• Able to present and discuss medical/scientific concepts.

• Meticulous attention to details.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

• Ability to travel

title: Defect Inspection Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

- Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

- Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

- Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

- Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

- Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

- Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

- Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

- Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

- Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

- A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

- Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

- Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

- Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

- Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

- Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

- Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

- Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

- A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

• Experience working in an Agile environment

• Experience supporting project teams of developers and data scientists who build web-based interfaces, dashboards, reports, and analytics/machine learning models

As Senior Counsel, Regulatory Legal - Latin America, you will be the legal voice on how Nu's payments and digital-assets products can operate, launch and scale across the region. This is a legal and regulatory strategy role, not a compliance operations role. You will own the regulatory path for what we build next, and you will be expected to say "here is the path I recommend", not just "here are the risks".

- Leading the legal analysis for entry into new markets and for the launch of new products, features and business models.

- Working with Product and business teams to structure products in line with applicable law, and proposing alternative structures when the initial model hits a regulatory obstacle.

- Coordinating license and registration applications (payments, financial services, virtual assets) and supporting engagement with regulators, central banks and other authorities, including on novel issues.

- Managing local external counsel while remaining accountable for synthesizing their input into a practical recommendation.

- Creating scalable frameworks, playbooks and decision trees so recurring questions are answered consistently across markets.

- Monitoring regulatory developments and separating what materially affects our strategy from general noise, and anticipating where regulation is heading on stablecoins, tokenized money, crypto-assets and new payment infrastructure.

- Briefing senior legal and business leaders on complex regulatory topics in clear, concise and commercially useful terms.

- Acting as a generalist legal business partner for new businesses in Latin America, coordinating a holistic legal approach, including support on agreements related to our products.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to 10s of GW.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview
Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.
You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.
About you
You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.
Responsibilities

• Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.

• With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.

• Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.

• Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.

• Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.

• Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.

• Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.

• Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.

Requirements

• Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.

• Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.

• Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.

• Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.

• Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.

Benefits

• €75-100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options

• 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)

• Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones

• 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days

• Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment

• AI tooling budget

• Quarterly health and wellness allowance

• Travel for conferences, events and our annual company meetup

title: Head of Marketing Operations
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Location: Open to Remote USA, but San Francisco, CA is preferred (hybrid)

ROLE OVERVIEW

CodeRabbit grew to $100M in just over a year, and growth is accelerating. In response to this marketing demand, we are building out a world-class marketing function made up of top talent with the budget and authority required to win. As part of that, we're hiring our first Head of Marketing Operations to turn our early GTM work into a world-class, AI-led marketing operations function.

You'll design how marketing operations should work at an AI-first company, including helping to shape marketing processes and methodologies, and architecting the data, systems, and tooling required to help both our self-service and sales-led businesses scale quickly. You won't have to start from scratch. We already have an extensive catalog of agentic marketing capabilities, advanced marketing analytics and modeling infrastructure, and advanced models powering lead scoring and enrichment. Today these pieces stand apart. You'll own them, maximize our investments, and create what comes next.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Define the vision, structure and methodology for an AI-led marketing operations function

- Own marketing systems, data, tooling and operations end to end, across both sales-led and self-service business lines

- Help build and run agents that automate and scale marketing workflows

- Unify our existing content, event management, paid media, analytics, scoring, and enrichment agentic infrastructure

- Assess the current stack and decide what to keep, replace or build

- Own data flows and integrations, including ETL, event tracking and the warehouse

- Select and manage vendors

- Partner closely with RevOps, data, engineering and campaign owners

QUALIFICATIONS

- Deep experience in marketing operations, including data, systems, process and vendor management

- Hands-on and technical: comfortable prompting and building your own agents in Claude, Codex or similar tools

- Strategic and creative, thinking in systems and methodology, not just shipping deliverables

- A builder who can solve problems with agents and automation

- Strong analytical skills and comfort working directly with data

- Comfortable operating at the pace of a hyper-growth AI company

- Bring passion, initiative, intelligence and integrity to your work

description:

We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

As a Robotic Sales Engineer (RSE), you are RobCo’s technical face to the customer and the technical lead on every deal you own, from the first customer call to a handover-ready solution. - Close the loop - Feed field insights back to Product, so what customers need shapes what we build.

The Principal, Enterprise Implementation is the single accountable owner, and the hands-on operator, of Fullbay ’s largest implementations, from pre-sale scoping through a stable go-live. These are multi-entity, multi-brand projects with significant technical, data, and project management interlock with senior customer executives. title: Protection Scientist Engineer, Integrity
description:
About the Team

The Integrity team is responsible for the scaled systems that help identify and respond to bad actors and harm on OpenAI’s platforms. We protect users and the wider world by developing responses to complex harms and building the harm protections needed for new product and model launches. Integrity’s work spans not only across frontier harms like biological weapons and cybersecurity, but also high severity abuses such as child safety, nation-state misuse, and violence.

About the Role

Protection Scientists within Integrity design, orchestrate, and mature systems of defence against usage harms enabled by OpenAI's products. We are systems thinkers that combine deep harm domain expertise with breadth across investigation, data science, machine learning, policy and operations. Our distinctive strength is understanding how these disciplines fit together and translating between them to design and build effective systems of defence.

In San Francisco, we are hiring for protection work focused on sextortion, trafficking, national security (including nation-state misuse), and jailbreaks. Depending on your domain expertise, your work could include identifying AI-enabled coercion and exploitation, detecting misuse that supports trafficking, uncovering coordinated activity by state-linked actors, or investigating attempts to circumvent model safeguards. You will translate these evolving threats into detection systems and interventions that reduce harm.

Your core hands-on technical responsibility is harm detection. You will design, build, evaluate and maintain production detection systems, drawing on investigative expertise, data and shared engineering platforms. You will develop signals and classifiers that identify abusive behaviour and patterns across accounts and activity, and adapt them as adversaries change tactics.

You will also own the strategy and cross-functional delivery of protection work for a harm area or product launch. Working closely with investigators and other domain experts, you will ground the design in a deep understanding of how the harm occurs and translate that understanding into a system of defence. You will connect detection with policy, review, interventions, enforcement and measurement, continually calibrating the system against real cases and expert judgement as it scales.

You will identify what needs to be built or changed and make it happen. Success requires setting clear priorities, aligning partners, resolving dependencies and communicating evidence, decisions and trade-offs crisply. It also requires a willingness to jump in and work directly on whatever is blocking system effectiveness, using your breadth of skills.

This role is based in our San Francisco office and includes participation in an on-call rotation that may involve resolving urgent escalations outside normal working hours. Some investigations may involve sensitive content, including sexual, violent or otherwise disturbing material.

- Define and drive protection strategy for a harm area or launch. Translate ambiguous risks into goals, priorities and roadmaps, and make trade-offs based on evidence, risk and available capacity.

- Directly build and maintain harm detection. Develop production signals, classifiers and pipelines using SQL, Python, machine learning and language models, integrating with shared engineering platforms.

- Lead cross-functional execution. Translate between specialist roles, establish shared understanding and ownership, resolve technical and organisational dependencies, and communicate recommendations and specific asks clearly.

About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. If you have experience with caseloads that include a comprehensive spectrum of mental health needs, from milder presentations to more complex and severe support, we encourage you to apply. If you're comfortable with evolving processes and excited by a rapidly growing business, then this role is for you!

title: Affiliate Marketing Manager
description:
Decodo is a web data infrastructure for fast-growing tech teams. It's a mid-market, self-service platform built for speed to value, so teams move from idea to implementation without procurement slowing them down.
The culture matches the product: decisions move at the speed of the idea, and people are trusted to test, iterate, and fix what's closest to them.
The team waiting for you
The Partnerships team owns the channels where other people recommend Decodo: affiliates, influencers, and technology partners. You will step in to own our established affiliate program end-to-end, bringing immediate value by managing the portfolio from partner discovery all the way to revenue results. With a new Team Lead and Technical Partnerships Manager joining, the team is currently being rebuilt for our next stage of growth, making this the perfect time to make your mark. Your underlying challenge will be turning a program that already works into a highly predictable, scalable growth channel, with real freedom to decide how you get there.

In this role, you will:

• Own the affiliate program end-to-end, managing commissions, budgets, and the overarching strategy to drive new paying customers and revenue.

• Manage and scale existing partners through regular contact, optimizing placements, and renegotiating deals to maximize performance.

• Research, pitch, and onboard new partners, focusing on tech/B2B publishers, comparison sites, newsletters, and developer-focused media.

• Track partner performance and efficiency metrics (such as ROAS and CPA) to make data-driven decisions on where to invest, what to fix, and what to cut.

• Ensure program integrity by monitoring traffic quality, brand-bidding, and coupon misuse, while maintaining up-to-date tracking and marketing materials.

• Work closely with SEO, Content, Design, and Product Marketing teams to launch landing pages and product offers, bringing valuable partner feedback back to the team.

Your skills & experience:

• 2+ years of hands-on experience in affiliate or partner marketing, with a proven track record of directly recruiting, managing, and growing a partner portfolio.

• Strong technical orientation, demonstrated by working at a tech product company, marketing to a developer audience, or utilizing technical tools (APIs, automations, no-code/AI tools) in your daily work.

• Exceptional data fluency, with the ability to easily read performance reports, calculate partner profitability, and drive strategic decisions.

• Confident communication skills in fluent written and spoken English, paired with strong cold outreach and negotiation capabilities.

• A high-ownership, self-starter mentality, ready to run the program independently and continuously grow within the role.

Nice to Have:

• Experience managing affiliate programs in B2B, SaaS, or tech products (e.g., VPN, hosting, security, developer tools).

• Hands-on experience in other performance marketing channels (SEO, PPC, influencers).

Salary & Benefits:

•
Gross salary: 11 900 - 15 800 PLN/month. Keep in mind that we are open to discuss a different salary based on your skills and competencies.

•
Growth & Learning: 40+ internal learning options, external conferences, mentorship, and year-round knowledge-sharing.

•
Celebration & Community: Team events, an overseas workation, quarterly team-building budgets, and plenty of ways to mark milestones together.

description:

We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

Summary:

The Bamboo Bridge Strategic Account Manager serves as a client partner and liaison across assigned regions, responsible for growth, retention, and strategic alignment of the Bamboo Bridge platform within payer and provider ecosystems. Serving as the primary point of contact, you’ll ensure client success through strategic and tactical oversight of all account activities. This includes fostering relationships with key stakeholders to ensure the Bamboo Bridge solution meets their evolving needs. The role focuses on account success and operational expansion - driving adoption of the Bamboo Bridge model, scaling existing use cases and associated pivotal care moments while also promoting uptake of additional use cases.

What You’ll Do:

• Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned provider and payer executives and other client stakeholders, ensuring all contractual commitments and key enablement factors for Bamboo Bridge engagement and adoption are met. Responsible for client account strategy, governance, and results to plan relative to Bamboo and client proformas.

• Drive adoption of the Bamboo Bridge operational playbook and scale use cases across assigned clients.

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with key provider and payer stakeholders to promote growth and ensure satisfaction.

• Track and analyze performance metrics and KPIs to confirm ROI delivery, alignment with strategic goals, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement or expansion to exceed client expectations.

• Lead strategic discussions and advise clients on enhancing behavioral health care navigation program effectiveness, positioning Bamboo Bridge as essential to their operations.

• Act as an escalation point for internal teams, ensuring timely project delivery and resolution of issues.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, Operations, and Engineering to deliver scopes of work, change orders, and service enhancement documentation with accuracy and professionalism.

• Identify and pursue upsell opportunities in partnership with internal teams to expand program scope or improve service delivery.

• Oversee successful contract renewals, extensions, project additions, and other contract modifications.

• Provide expert insights to clients on integrating Bamboo Bridge within broader public health initiatives and systems.

• Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

What Success Looks Like:

In 3 months…

- Drive KYB processes that support a diversified, high-quality merchant portfolio.

- Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with demonstrated experience assessing counterparty or merchant credit risk.

- Practical experience with ongoing credit monitoring, limit setting and early-warning frameworks for merchant portfolios.

- Strong understanding of payment flows and how settlement timing, reserves and chargebacks affect credit exposure.

- Experience identifying and escalating emerging credit risks across payment products and geographies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain credit findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities with precision and attention to detail.

- An ownership mindset: you take accountability, drive clarity and execute with urgency.

PREFERRED

- Advanced proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL.

- Familiarity with card brand monitoring, compliance and KYB/KYC requirements.

- Experience managing credit exposure for merchants or partners within fintech, payments or financial institutions.

- Background in regulatory compliance or operational risk management.

- A track record of defining and reporting KPIs to improve process performance.

- Deep understanding of payment processing systems and associated credit, fraud and operational risks.

YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

- You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

- You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.
